Strategy: Replace the flat sweet-band bonus with a triangular one peaking at leftover 35, giving +30 at the peak and tapering to +20 at the edges of [25,45], so bins near the ideal residual win more strongly than bins at the band margins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 - abs((r - item) - 35) if 25 <= r - item <= 45 else 0) for r in bins]
```
